_comment: A lens is a subject whose own history a story can draw Beginnings from (T-0076, docs/decisions.md). Matched on the object's Title, rule-based, so the editor can read and change it. A story's row can be shared by many subjects; the lens is what the story is about. Rule: per lens, the most recent three linked objects dated before the story's origin; a provisional row needs at least three in all, otherwise it shows its origin alone. A lens with fewer than three linked objects is a gap to fill through the staging workbook.
